steps.content: "Chief, we're really glad we met you. If fate allows it, I hope... our paths cross again."
When you open your eyes again, the simulation device is still silent on the ground. You press the button.
No light erupts, no surge of Mania this time. The scene inside is simply a gallery—ordinary, belonging to Eastside.
A quiet smile touches your lips. Without a word, you lay the device next to the Cat's Eye calling card, securing both within your collection.
